picks.title: HOPPR releases whole-body MSK x-ray report drafting model
picks.excerpt: HOPPR is launching a beta of its FS MSK Whole-Body Narrative Model, a vision-language foundation model that generates draft findings text for musculoskeletal radiographs using up to three views per study.
picks.rationale: A new product release with real AI content: HOPPR's vision-language foundation model drafts findings text for whole-body MSK radiographs, so it changes how radiologists produce reports. The recent fracture cards (10-28 ChatGPT-5 wrist study, 10-29 radiographer ED study) evaluated detection, not report drafting, and no HOPPR story is in the 30-day history.

dedup.note: This pick replaces Deep Reasoning AI NeuroDR (AuntMinnie), which was dropped because AI appears only in the company name. The swap curator had Read access only and could not exact-grep published_urls.json for HOPPR across all sections, so the orchestrator should check it before roll.
